## What this decides

⚠ The first run of this join reported 1,579 independent gaps. Every one was a false gap from
building the identity map out of the worklist (absences only) instead of the full source walk.

V36 §1.4 measured n=25 gap instruments and found the SOURCE richer than legacy in 11 and legacy
richer in 0, so the standing decision is **re-fetch, do not migrate**. That decision is unchanged
by this join. What the join settles is how much of the legacy table is even a candidate:
127,417 instruments are already held, 344 are already scheduled, and only
**29** are neither — so the legacy table's independent contribution is 211
sections, not 914,274.
